title: A graded coefficientwise base change maps the target irrelevant ideal into the source image
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings. Let $A=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}A_n$ be a commutative $R$-algebra with a nonnegative grading by $R$-submodules [def-sfb-nonnegative-graded-algebra], and let $B=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}B_n$ be a commutative $S$-algebra with a nonnegative grading by $S$-submodules [def-sfb-nonnegative-graded-algebra]; regard $B$ as an $R$-algebra through $R\to S$. Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a ring homomorphism with $\varphi(A_n)\subseteq B_n$ for all $n$ and $\varphi(r\cdot1_A)=r\cdot1_B$ for all $r\in R$, so that each restriction $\varphi_n:A_n\to B_n$ is $R$-linear. Assume that $\varphi$ is a coefficientwise base change: for every $n\ge0$ the $S$-linear map $S\otimes_R A_n\to B_n$, $s\otimes a\mapsto s\,\varphi(a)$, is bijective. Write $A_+=\bigoplus_{n>0}A_n$ and $B_+=\bigoplus_{n>0}B_n$ for the irrelevant ideals. Then $B_+$ is contained in the ideal of $B$ generated by $\varphi(A_+)$: $B_+\subseteq\varphi(A_+)B$.
